title: SA-generation-legacy-dataset-paper
summary: A research repository implementing a Stochastic Attention model for generating synthetic patients from a legacy pregnancy dataset. Its experiments script trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer as baseline comparisons against the proposed method.
evidence: code/experiments/run_ctgan_baseline.py:8-119 imports CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and trains both as baselines
